title: Concrete Mixer Maintenance Window Notification
gherkin:
Feature: Lifecycle Notification Generation
  Scenario: Generate notification for Concrete Mixer maintenance
    Given a Concrete Mixer is in operation
    When the maintenance window is reached
    Then a lifecycle notification should be generated for the Concrete Mixer maintenance
rationale: To ensure that the system correctly generates notifications for Concrete Mixers when they reach their 12-hour maintenance window.
usedContextItems: Concrete Mixers must have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window

From: ops_lead@toolchain.com
To: dev_leads@toolchain.com, pm_team@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)

Subject: Registration consent flow must be revised before launch

Hi All,

During the latest compliance review, Legal raised a blocking concern regarding how consent is collected in the registration journey.

At the moment, the current approach appears to bundle multiple legal acknowledgements too closely. For launch readiness, users need to express consent to the contractual terms and the personal-data-related notice in a clearly distinguishable way. A single combined acknowledgement is not sufficient for this purpose.

Please adjust the registration flow so that these approvals are captured independently and can be demonstrated separately if needed during audit.

This is a release-blocking compliance item.

Best regards,

Dr. Arpad Jog
General Counsel

Subject: Question about promotional content in reminder communications

Hi Team,

For the beta period, Marketing would like to explore whether reminder-style emails could also carry a small promotional or onboarding message, instead of treating product messaging and operational reminders as completely separate streams.

Before we move in that direction, we need guidance on how this should interact with user notification settings. From a campaign perspective, the reminder channel looks attractive because it already reaches active users at important points in the rental journey. However, we do not want to assume that a message containing both operational and promotional content should automatically follow the same preference rules as a purely operational reminder.

Please advise whether this needs a dedicated notification category, a separate consent decision, or a strict separation between transactional and promotional messaging.

Best,
Marketing Dept.
